items.event_time_ist: Poll released Oct 9, 2026 (fielded Sept 30-Oct 5); Obama endorsement video released Oct 8, 2026
items.summary: A Washington Post-Schar School poll of 800 likely voters (fielded Sept 30-Oct 5, MoE +/-3.6) has Democrat Troy Jackson at 50% vs five-term incumbent Susan Collins at 46%. Jackson leads 53-40 among independents; 52% say Collins' 30 years in the Senate are a bad thing, and 63% disapprove of Trump. The same week, Barack Obama released a video endorsing Jackson and Bernie Sanders campaigned with him in Maine; the candidates have completed two of four debates. Maine early voting runs Oct 5-29.
items.title: Maine Senate: new WaPo-Schar poll has Jackson (D) 50, Collins (R) 46 as Obama endorses Jackson

items.event_time_ist: Reported Oct 5, 2026; Detroit rally scheduled Oct 24, 2026
items.summary: Barack Obama will campaign with Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed and gubernatorial nominee Jocelyn Benson at a Detroit GOTV rally Oct 24 - the first day of Michigan's mandatory in-person early voting period. Obama has taped 24 ads for Democratic Senate and gubernatorial candidates to be released in the coming weeks, and this week headlined a Washington fundraiser for Senate Democrats. Earlier this cycle he appeared in an ad for Iowa Senate candidate Josh Turek and campaigned in Texas with James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa.
items.title: Obama ramps up midterm involvement: Detroit rally Oct 24 with El-Sayed and Benson; 24 recorded ads

items.source_name: Albuquerque Journal poll (via petedinelli.com) / Silver Bulletin average
items.summary: Research & Polling Inc.'s final poll for the Albuquerque Journal (1,125 likely voters, MoE +/-2.9) has Democrat Deb Haaland at 49% vs Republican Gregg Hull at 42%, with 9% undecided. Haaland leads among women, Hispanics and independents (48-34). The Silver Bulletin polling average (updated Oct 11) has Haaland +7.9, and a late-September KOB/SurveyUSA poll had her 47-41. Obama endorsed Haaland in a video released Oct 7; Hull has been endorsed by ex-Gov. Gary Johnson. Early voting began Oct 6; expanded sites open Oct 17.
items.title: New Mexico governor: Albuquerque Journal's final poll has Haaland 49, Hull 42

items.summary: DHM Research's poll commissioned by The Oregonian (549 likely voters, MoE +/-4.2, within the margin) puts incumbent Democrat Tina Kotek at 46% vs Republican Christine Drazan at 44% - the first publicly reported poll of this general election cycle with Kotek ahead. Kotek's campaign internal (GBAO, Oct 1-4, 800 LV) has her 46-42. But an OPB-commissioned DHM poll from late September had Drazan 47-46, and the Silver Bulletin average has Kotek +2.0. Cook and Sabato rate the race Lean D. Oregon's registration deadline is Oct 13 and ballots mail starting Oct 14.
items.title: Oregon governor: Kotek posts first public-poll lead of the cycle (46-44); race still a toss-up
